events.text: CP Foods earned its first 'RE100 Farm' certification from LRQA (Thailand) for Thailand's first 100% renewable energy farm.
In 2025, CPF became the first food producer with SBTi-validated near-term and long-term net-zero targets for 2050.
In 2025, CPF achieved 100% coal-free operations across nine countries.
In 2025, CPF conducted a sustainability materiality assessment across its agro-industrial and food value chain.

A Thai court accepted a class action lawsuit against Charoen Pokphand Foods for causing environmental damage from the rapid spread of an invasive fish species, a lawyer for the plaintiffs told Reuters.

Charoen Pokphand Foods filed a defamation lawsuit against BIOTHAI Foundation secretary-general Witoon Lianchamroon over invasive fish crisis claims; he appeared in court on October 22 to face the charges.
In 2025, the Company conducted a sustainability materiality assessment across its agro-industrial and food value chain.

On April 3, 2023, CPFRF, a subsidiary of Charoen Pokphand Foods, acquired the 'FIVE STAR' trademarks and service marks registered in 12 countries from Charoen Pokphand Group Co., Ltd., the Company's major shareholder.
Charoen Pokphand Foods PCL announced its commitment to achieving Net Zero Emissions by 2050.
Charoen Pokphand Foods (CPF) faced the first hearing in a defamation lawsuit it brought in Thailand against an environmental group that allegedly suggested the company introduced blackchin tilapia.
BIOTHAI Foundation secretary-general Witoon Lianchamroon appeared in court on October 22 to face defamation charges filed by Charoen Pokphand Foods (CPF).

Charoen Pokphand Foods CEO Prasit Boondoungprasert unveiled the company's ESG strategy for the net-zero transition by 2050, focusing on accelerating renewable energy, improving efficiency and phasing out coal use, at Sustainability Forum 2022: The People and the Planet.
As of 2025, Charoen Pokphand Foods has disclosed 7 climate targets to reduce its GHG emissions, including 6 absolute reduction targets and 1 intensity-based target.
Charoen Pokphand Foods' near- and long-term science-based targets were validated by the SBTi, making it the first food processing company with FLAG targets.
In 2025, Charoen Pokphand Foods conducted a sustainability materiality assessment across its agro-industrial and food value chain.
Witoon Lianchamroon, secretary-general of the BIOTHAI Foundation, appeared in court on October 22 to face charges filed by Charoen Pokphand Foods (CPF).
